_comment: Copy me to companion.config.json and fill in your own paths. That file is gitignored -- a save path is personal.
_rom: Your patched Blaze Black ROM. Needed once, by ./setup, to extract the game's own tables. Never modified.
_vanilla_rom: Optional. An unmodified Pokemon Black ROM, used only to prove the extractor's field offsets and to diff hack-vs-vanilla.
_backups: Optional. Where pre-install backups go. Defaults to save_backups/ in this repo.
